model: Nomad Mk3 650b with Rohloff and disc brakes
description: This is a new build a Thorn Nomad Mk3 650B with a straight bar and Rohloff gears. This bike would suit a rider of 1752mm (5ft 9 in) to 1854 mm (6ft 1in).Virtual top tube 615 mm. Standover hight at mid tube 820mm. This bike would be ideal for expedition rides , distance touring, commuting or weekly shop or would happily be your lifetime mode of transport. Details Thorn Nomad Mk3 - Gunmetal 58L- 650b Thorn Nomad Mk3 steel Thru axle disc brake fork - Gunmetal If unsure of size please contact Thorn on 01278 441505, Monday to Thursday from 8.00am to 4.00pm or sales@thorncycles.co.uk.We do have a showroom that you can visit by appointment.
